body.label: Target
body.html: A line of 3 connected spaces within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the line is difficult terrain for enemies that can detect you. This is suppressive fire, not a physical barrier.

surges.html: One enemy currently in the line is Distracted until the start of your next turn; compare your Success Die to its Composure.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: If your Locked target voluntarily crosses the line before your next turn, you may end Lock to deal 1 weapon Damage to it. This rider resolves once.
